representation.prompts: Native HTML and KaTeX for every prompt with original wording, part labels, marks, bold emphasis, question-specific instructions and faithful vector figure crops (captions retained).
representation.solutions: Every question-specific mark-scheme page as ordered vector crops: working, marks, AOs, alternatives, special cases, examiner notes and diagrams. General marking pages and publisher pages are excluded.

cropMethod: PyMuPDF show_pdf_page clip to SVG with text as paths. Figure boxes snap to the drawing items wholly inside the caption region. Scheme page bounds cover all text spans, vector drawings and embedded images; breaks fall only in empty horizontal bands, preferring table rules and paragraph gaps; invisible white background fills are ignored when finding bands.
sourceNotes: 9FM0/01 Q8 uses T hours while t is in days; kept verbatim, the scheme converts.
9MA0/01 mark scheme page 36 shows an empty box for an unembedded SymbolMT glyph in "3x + 2y ... 5"; the supplied PDF renders the same box, so the crop is faithful and unchanged.
mathsReview: Every question solved independently with SymPy and numeric checks (private scripts) and compared with the official scheme answers; no discrepancies and no source errors found.

questions.mathsCheckpoint: g(3) = 81 - 180 + 3k + 51 + k = 0 gives k = 12. Agrees with scheme.
(1 - 9x)^(1/2) = 1 - 9x/2 - 81x^2/8 - 729x^3/16; valid only for |x| < 1/9, so x = -2/9 is outside. Agrees with scheme.
f(3.6) = -0.686 < 0, f(3.7) = 0.212 > 0, continuous; f'(x) = 1 + (1/2)sec^2(x/2); Newton–Raphson from 3.7 gives 3.672. Agrees with scheme.
((x+h)^2 - x^2)/h = 2x + h -> 2x as h -> 0. Agrees with scheme.
f'(x) = (-2x^2 + 6x + 8)/(x^2+4)^2 (a = -2, b = 6, c = 8); decreasing for x <= -1 or x >= 4. Agrees with scheme.
P = (2, 5); 16 - 4x = 3|x-2| + 5 only on the left branch: x = 17/7; line through (0, 4) meets both branches for 1/2 < k < 3. Agrees with scheme.
H = 0.6e^(-0.2t) + 0.9 (A = 0.6, B = 0.9); H = 1.2 at t = 5ln2 = 3.466 h = 3 h 28 min; long-term height 0.9 m. Agrees with scheme.
fg(2) = 1; g^-1(x) = (5 + 9x)/(2x), x != 0; gf(x) = -5/(6x^2 + 1), range -5 <= gf(x) < 0; 5x^2 - 6x + k - 4 = 0 has no real roots for k > 29/5. Agrees with scheme.
Common ratio condition 3^(4(7-2k)) = 3^(4k-5) 3^(2k-2) gives 28 - 8k = 6k - 7, k = 5/2; terms 243, 81, 27, r = 1/3, sum to infinity 729/2. Agrees with scheme.
y(4) = 32 - 32 = 0; gradient -12 at x = 4 gives 12x + y = 48; lines meet at (12/5, 96/5); R = triangle 192/5 minus integral of the curve from 0 to 4 (192/7) = 384/35. Agrees with scheme.
Arc OB centre A radius 5 meets the semicircle where angle BOC = 60 degrees; R = semicircle minus sector A minus segment = 25sqrt3/4 + 25pi/6. Agrees with scheme.

K = 500, alpha = 73.74 degrees; A = 1000, R = 1000 + 500cos(30t + 73.74), minimum 500 at t = 3.54 (mid-April, so the model fits); fox minimum when 30T + 70 = 270, T = 20/3, rabbits 1033 (scheme accepts 1032 or 1033). Agrees with scheme.
dx = 2a sin cos dtheta, integrand becomes 2a^2 sin^2 cos^2 = (1/2)a^2 sin^2 2theta, limits 0 to pi/2; integral = pi a^2/8, k = 1/8. Agrees with scheme.
dr/dt = k/sqrt r; 0.9 = k/4 gives k = 3.6; (2/3)r^(3/2) = 3.6t + c with r(10) = 16 gives r^(3/2) = 5.4t + 10; r(20) = 118^(2/3) = 24.1 cm; balloon cannot grow without limit. Agrees with scheme.
k^2 - 4k + 5 = (k-2)^2 + 1 > 0; contradiction proof checks the factor pairs of 28 with 3x + 2y >= 5 (28 x 1, 14 x 2, 7 x 4), none gives positive integers. Agrees with scheme.

questions.mathsCheckpoint: dy/dx = 12x^2 - 14x + 5; d2y/dx2 = 24x - 14 = 0 at x = 7/12. Agrees with scheme.
u12 = 400 - 11(10) = 290; S_N = N/2(800 - 10(N-1)) = 8100 gives N^2 - 81N + 1620 = 0, N = 36 or 45; N = 45 would need negative payments, so N = 36. Agrees with scheme.
u2 = 6k - 5, u3 = k(6k - 5) - 5 = -1 gives 6k^2 - 5k - 4 = 0; k = 4/3 (positive); u = 6, 3, -1, sum 8. Agrees with scheme.
theta(2theta)/(9theta^2/2) = 4/9. Agrees with scheme.
f'(x) = 8xe^(4x^2-1), g'(x) = 8/x; equating gives 4x^2 + 2ln x - 1 = 0; x2 = 0.7109, iteration converges to alpha = 0.6706. Agrees with scheme.
AB = 3i + 9j + 3k; |AP| = 2|BP| on l gives P = 4i + 3j + 7k or 8i + 15j + 11k. Agrees with scheme.
Combined fraction 2cosec/cot^2 = 2tan sec; equation becomes tan^2 2x = 1/2, x = 17.6 or 72.4 degrees. Agrees with scheme.
H = -0.03x^2 + 0.54x + 2; H(16) = 2.96 > 2.5, so Chandra cannot catch it. Agrees with scheme.
P at t = -1; dy/dx = -3t^2/(2(t+3)) = -3/4 gives 3x + 4y = 20; greatest height y(-2) = 9 m. Agrees with scheme.
Integration by parts twice: area = 16/27 - (136/27)e^(-3). Agrees with scheme.
1/(V(25-V)) = (1/25)(1/V + 1/(25-V)); time = (2/5)ln6 h = 43 minutes; V = 100/(e^(-2.5t) + 4) (A = 100, B = 4, k = 2.5), satisfies the DE with V(0) = 20; L = 25 as e^(-2.5t) -> 0. Agrees with scheme.
a = 10^0.81 = 6.457, b = 10^0.0054 = 1.013; P(26) is about 9 billion; extrapolation beyond 2004-2007 is unreliable. Agrees with scheme.
Centre (3, -7), radius 5; centres sqrt82 apart, so sqrt82 - 5 < k < sqrt82 + 5. Agrees with scheme.
dy/dx = (2x - (x+y)^2)/((x+y)^2 + 1), 1/2 at P, normal y = -2x + 2; substituting gives -(x - 1)(x^2 - 2x + 16) = 0, and x^2 - 2x + 16 has discriminant -60 < 0, so only P. Agrees with scheme.

questions.mathsCheckpoint: R = 0.5g = 4.9 N; limiting friction X = (2/7)(4.9) = 1.4 N. Agrees with scheme.
Acceleration 10/4 = 2.5 m s^-2; distance to t = 18 is 20 + 140 = 160 m; remaining 40 m over 6 s gives (10 + U)/2 x 6 = 40, U = 10/3. Agrees with scheme.
R = mg cos(alpha) = 12mg/13; mg(5/13) - mu(12mg/13) = ma gives a = g(5 - 12mu)/13; if mu >= 5/12, P stays at rest. Agrees with scheme.

At t = 4, r = 2c i - 6 j on bearing 135 degrees gives c = 3; v = (3/2)t^(-1/2) i - (3/4)t j, speed 3 sqrt(17)/4 = 3.09 m s^-1; a = -(3/4)t^(-3/2) i - (3/4) j parallel to -i - 27j gives T = 9. Agrees with scheme.
x = 28t, y = 21t - 4.9t^2 gives y = 3x/4 - x^2/160; OA = 120 m; H = 22.5 m; air resistance reduces the height so H > K. Agrees with scheme.

questions.mathsCheckpoint: 2-5i is also a root; f(2+5i)=0 gives a=42, b=-78; quartic factorises (z^2-4z+29)(z^2-2z+5), other roots 2-5i, 1+2i, 1-2i. Agrees with scheme.
Sum 3/2, pair sum 6, product -7/2; (i) 2(6)/(-7/2) = -24/7; (ii) -9; (iii) (3/2)^2 - 12 = -39/4. Agrees with scheme.
Shortest distance 6 - (4 + a) = 0.5 gives a = 1.5; pool area (1/2) integral of (4 - 1.5 sin 3theta)^2 over 0..2pi = 137pi/8; T = 36pi - 137pi/8 = 151pi/8 m^2. Agrees with scheme.

z^n + z^-n = 2cos n theta; (z + 1/z)^5 expansion gives cos^5 theta = (cos5theta + 5cos3theta + 10cos theta)/16; equation becomes 16cos^5 theta + 2cos theta = 0 so cos theta = 0, theta = pi/2, 3pi/2. Agrees with scheme.

Integrating factor (t+2)^3 with v(0)=0 gives v = k(t+2)/4 - 1 + 4(2-k)/(t+2)^3; v(2)=4 gives k = 26/5; v(5) = 8.06 m s^-1; v grows without limit for large t (no terminal velocity). Agrees with scheme.
Sum of (2r-1)^2 = n(4n^2-1)/3 verified symbolically; induction base n=1 gives 1. Agrees with scheme.
3i-10j-k is perpendicular to both directions; plane 3x - 10y - z = 20; p = 0.2; A = (5.6, 0.3, -6.2); angle between AB and the plane is 40 degrees to the nearest degree. Agrees with scheme.

Eliminating y gives x'' - 4x' + 5x = 0; x = e^(2t)(A cos t + B sin t), y = e^(2t)((A+B)cos t + (B-A)sin t); A=100, B=175; x=y when tan t = 1.75, t = 1.0517 days so T = 25.24 hours (the paper states T in hours). Agrees with scheme.

questions.mathsCheckpoint: Exponential definition verifies 4sinh^3x + 3sinh x = sinh3x; sinh3x = 19sinh x gives sinh x (4sinh^2 x - 16) = 0, so x = 0, ln(2 + sqrt5), ln(-2 + sqrt5). Agrees with scheme.
f'(x) = -1/(2x+3); f''(x) = 2/(2x+3)^2; f(0) = artanh(1/2) = ln sqrt3, series ln sqrt3 - x/3 + x^2/9 (p = sqrt3, q = -1/3, r = 1/9). Agrees with scheme.
Infinite upper limit makes it improper; integral = pi/48, k = 1/48. Agrees with scheme.
Partial fractions 1/(r+4) - 1/(r+6); sum = n(11n + 61)/(30(n+5)(n+6)), a = 11, b = 61. Agrees with scheme.
Circle centre 4 radius 4 through O (r = 8cos theta); ray arg z = pi/3; region area = integral of 32cos^2 theta from 0 to pi/3 = 16pi/3 + 4sqrt3. Agrees with scheme.

CF Ae^(-2t) + Be^(-t/2), PI 2t + 1; with x(0) = 3, x'(0) = -2: x = 2t + 1 + 2e^(-2t); minimum at t = ln2/2 with x = 2 + ln2, x'' = 4 > 0; speed tends to 2, consistent with constant speed. Agrees with scheme.
z^6 = 1: e^(ik pi/3), k = 0..5; (sqrt3 + i)^6 = -64; z^6 + 64 = 0: 2e^(i(2k+1)pi/6). Agrees with scheme.
C at t = 0 with x = 2 (neck radius) and y = 7 gives a = 2, b = 7; body volume pi integral of x^2 dy = 588pi/5, plus neck cylinder 18pi, total 678pi/5 = 426 cm^3. Agrees with scheme.
